name: Animate Dead
summary: Raise a Small or Medium corpse or bones as a zombie or skeleton that obeys you for 24 hours; two more undead per slot above 3rd.

name: Ashardalon's Stride
summary: Your speed rises by 20 ft and anything you move within 5 ft of takes 1d6 fire (once per turn); +5 ft speed and +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Aura of Vitality
summary: 30-ft healing aura: each turn as a bonus action, one creature in it regains 2d6 HP.

repeat.label: Aura of Vitality: heal
repeat.desc: One creature in the aura regains 2d6 HP.

name: Beacon of Hope
summary: Any number of creatures in range get advantage on Wisdom and death saves and regain the maximum possible from healing.

name: Bestow Curse
summary: Touch; WIS save or cursed: disadvantage on one ability, wasted turns, or an extra 1d8 necrotic from your attacks. Longer duration at higher slots.

name: Blinding Smite
summary: Your next melee weapon hit deals +3d8 radiant and the target must pass a CON save or be blinded (it repeats the save each turn).

name: Blink
summary: For 1 minute, roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns; on 11+ you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until your next turn.

name: Call Lightning
summary: A storm cloud lets you call a bolt each turn on a point: 5-ft radius, DEX save, 3d10 lightning (half on save); +1d10 per slot.

repeat.label: Call Lightning: bolt
repeat.desc: Call another bolt down on a point.

name: Catnap
summary: Up to three willing creatures fall asleep and gain the benefit of a short rest after 10 minutes; +1 creature per slot.

name: Clairvoyance
summary: Create an invisible sensor at a familiar or obvious location within a mile to see or hear through.

name: Conjure Animals
summary: Summon fey spirits as beasts (one CR 2, two CR 1, four CR 1/2 or eight CR 1/4) that obey you; more at higher slots.

name: Conjure Barrage
summary: Throw a weapon or ammunition to fill a 60-ft cone: DEX save, 3d8 of the weapon's damage type, half on save.

name: Counterspell
summary: Reaction: interrupt a spell being cast; 3rd level or lower fails, higher needs a check against DC 10 + its level. Upcasting raises the automatic level.

name: Create Food and Water
summary: Create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water, enough for fifteen people for a day.

name: Crusader's Mantle
summary: 30-ft aura: you and friendly creatures in it deal an extra 1d4 radiant on weapon hits.

name: Daylight
summary: A 60-ft sphere of bright light (dim for 60 more) that dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower.

name: Dispel Magic
summary: End spells of 3rd level or lower on a target; higher ones need a check against DC 10 + the spell's level. Upcasting raises the automatic level.

name: Elemental Weapon
summary: A weapon becomes +1 and deals +1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder; +2/2d4 with a 5th-level slot, +3/3d4 with 7th.

name: Enemies Abound
summary: INT save or the target sees every creature as an enemy and picks attack targets at random; it repeats the save when it takes damage.

name: Erupting Earth
summary: A 20-ft cube of ground erupts: DEX save, 3d12 bludgeoning (half on save) and the area becomes difficult terrain; +1d12 per slot.

name: Fear
summary: 30-ft cone: WIS save or drop what you hold and become frightened, dashing away; save repeats only when out of sight of you.

name: Feign Death
summary: A willing creature appears dead for an hour: blinded, incapacitated, resistant to all damage but psychic.

name: Fireball
summary: A bead explodes in a 20-ft sphere: DEX save, 8d6 fire, half on save; +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Flame Arrows
summary: Up to twelve arrows or bolts from a quiver deal +1d6 fire on a hit; +2 pieces of ammunition per slot.

name: Fly
summary: A touched creature gains a 60-ft flying speed for 10 minutes; +1 target per slot.

name: Gaseous Form
summary: A willing creature becomes a slow-flying mist (10 ft fly) that resists nonmagical damage and can slip through cracks.

name: Glyph of Warding
summary: Inscribe a glyph that triggers an explosion (5d8, DEX save half) or a stored spell of 3rd level or lower. 200 gp diamond.

name: Haste
summary: A willing creature gets double speed, +2 AC, advantage on DEX saves and an extra limited action; when it ends the target loses its next turn.

name: Hunger of Hadar
summary: 20-ft sphere of void darkness: starting a turn inside deals 2d6 cold, ending one deals 2d6 acid (DEX save negates); difficult terrain. +1d6 each per slot.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
summary: 30-ft cube of shifting colours: WIS save or charmed and incapacitated with speed 0 until damaged or shaken awake.

name: Intellect Fortress
summary: One creature gains psychic resistance and advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves; +1 target per slot.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
summary: A 10-ft dome that creatures and magic you don't allow cannot pass, lasting 8 hours.

name: Life Transference
summary: You take 4d8 necrotic that can't be reduced, and a creature you choose regains twice that; +1d8 per slot.

name: Lightning Arrow
summary: Your next ranged weapon attack becomes lightning: 4d8 on a hit (half on a miss), and creatures within 10 ft make a DEX save for 2d8. +1d8 each per slot.

name: Lightning Bolt
summary: A 100-ft line of lightning: DEX save, 8d6 lightning, half on save; +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Magic Circle
summary: A 10-ft cylinder that keeps a chosen creature type (celestial, elemental, fey, fiend or undead) out, or traps one inside.

name: Major Image
summary: An illusion up to a 20-ft cube with sound, smell and temperature; permanent if cast with a 6th-level slot.

name: Mass Healing Word
summary: Bonus action: up to six creatures you can see regain 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP; +1d4 per slot.

name: Meld into Stone
summary: Step into a stone surface and stay hidden inside it for up to 8 hours.

name: Melf's Minute Meteors
summary: Six tiny meteors orbit you; send one or two per turn (bonus action) at points within 120 ft: 5-ft radius, DEX save, 2d6 fire, half on save. +2 meteors per slot.

repeat.label: Melf's Meteors: launch
repeat.desc: Send two meteors at a point (5-ft radius, DEX save, 2d6 fire each).

name: Nondetection
summary: For 8 hours a creature, place or object can't be targeted by divination or seen by scrying sensors.

name: Phantom Steed
summary: Summon a quasi-real horse with 100 ft speed for an hour.

name: Plant Growth
summary: Plants in a 100-ft radius become overgrown so each foot of movement costs 4 ft, or enrich land for a year.

name: Protection from Energy
summary: A creature gains resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (your choice) for up to an hour.

name: Pulse Wave
summary: 30-ft cone: CON save, 6d6 force and pushed or pulled 15 ft (half, no move on save); +1d6 and +5 ft per slot.

name: Remove Curse
summary: End every curse on a creature or object and break attunement to a cursed item.

name: Revivify
summary: Return a creature that died within the last minute to life with 1 HP (300 gp diamond consumed).

name: Sending
summary: Send a 25-word message to a familiar creature anywhere; it can reply at once.

name: Sleet Storm
summary: A 40-ft-radius cylinder of sleet: heavily obscured, difficult terrain, DEX save or fall prone, and concentration saves for casters inside.

name: Slow
summary: Up to six creatures in a 40-ft cube: WIS save or speed halved, -2 AC and DEX saves, no reactions, and only one attack or action per turn.

name: Speak with Dead
summary: A corpse answers up to five questions with what it knew in life.

name: Speak with Plants
summary: Talk with plants within 30 ft and make overgrown terrain passable or difficult.

name: Spirit Guardians
summary: Spirits fill a 15-ft aura around you: enemies' speed is halved and those starting a turn there make a WIS save, 3d8 radiant (or necrotic), half on save. +1d8 per slot.

name: Spirit Shroud
summary: Your attacks against creatures within 10 ft deal +1d8 radiant, necrotic or cold and stop them regaining HP; +1d8 per two slots above 3rd.

name: Stinking Cloud
summary: A 20-ft sphere of nauseating gas: creatures starting a turn inside make a CON save or lose their action retching; heavily obscured.

name: Summon Fey
summary: Call a fey spirit (fuming, mirthful or tricksy) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Summon Lesser Demons
summary: Summon hostile minor demons that attack the nearest creatures; more at higher slots.

name: Summon Shadowspawn
summary: Call a shadow spirit (fury, despair or fear) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Summon Undead
summary: Call an undead spirit (ghostly, putrid or skeletal) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Thunder Step
summary: Teleport up to 90 ft, optionally with an adjacent willing creature; creatures within 10 ft of where you left make a CON save, 3d10 thunder, half on save. +1d10 per slot.

name: Tidal Wave
summary: A 30-ft-long wave crashes down: DEX save, 4d8 bludgeoning and knocked prone; half and stays standing on save.

name: Tiny Servant
summary: Touch a Tiny object to animate it as a servant (AC 15, 10 HP, Slam +5 for 1d4+3) for 8 hours; two more objects per slot above 3rd. Cast before combat.

name: Tongues
summary: A creature understands any spoken language and is understood by all who hear it for an hour.

name: Vampiric Touch
summary: Melee spell attack for 3d6 necrotic; you regain half the damage dealt. Repeat as an action each turn. +1d6 per slot.

name: Wall of Sand
summary: A 30-ft-long wall of swirling sand blocks sight; moving through it costs 3 ft per foot.

name: Wall of Water
summary: A 30-ft wall of water: difficult terrain, ranged attacks through it have disadvantage and fire damage through it is halved.

name: Water Breathing
summary: Up to ten creatures can breathe underwater for 24 hours.

name: Water Walk
summary: Up to ten creatures can walk on liquid surfaces for an hour.

name: Wind Wall
summary: A 50-ft wall of strong wind: STR save on appearing, 3d8 bludgeoning (half on save); blocks arrows, gas and small fliers.

name: Arcane Eye
summary: Create an invisible floating eye with darkvision that you can move and see through for an hour.

name: Aura of Life
summary: 30-ft aura: allies resist necrotic, their HP max can't be reduced, and allies at 0 HP regain 1 HP at the start of their turn.

name: Aura of Purity
summary: 30-ft aura: allies can't be diseased, resist poison, and have advantage on saves against many conditions.

name: Banishment
summary: CHA save or the target is sent to a harmless demiplane (or home, permanently, if extraplanar and held 1 minute); +1 target per slot.

name: Blight
summary: Drain moisture from a creature: CON save, 8d8 necrotic, half on save (plants suffer worse); +1d8 per slot.

name: Charm Monster
summary: WIS save (advantage if fighting) or a creature is charmed by you for an hour; +1 target per slot.

name: Compulsion
summary: Creatures you choose make a WIS save or must use movement each turn heading in a direction you pick.

name: Confusion
summary: 10-ft sphere: WIS save or act randomly each turn and lose reactions (repeat save each turn); +5 ft radius per slot.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
summary: Summon elementals (one CR 2 up to eight CR 1/4) that obey you; more at higher slots.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
summary: Summon fey creatures (one CR 2 up to eight CR 1/4) that obey you; more at higher slots.

name: Control Water
summary: Flood, part, redirect or whirlpool water in a 100-ft cube.

name: Death Ward
summary: The first time the target would drop to 0 HP it drops to 1 instead, or it ignores one instant-death effect.

name: Dimension Door
summary: Teleport up to 500 ft, optionally with one willing adjacent creature.

name: Divination
summary: Ask your god one question about a goal or event within the next week and get a truthful reply.

name: Dominate Beast
summary: WIS save (advantage if fighting) or a beast is charmed and follows your commands; it saves again when damaged. Longer at higher slots.

name: Elemental Bane
summary: CON save or the target loses resistance to a chosen element and takes +2d6 of it the first time it's hurt by it each turn; +1 target per slot.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
summary: A 20-ft square of tentacles: difficult terrain; entering or starting a turn there needs a DEX save or 3d6 bludgeoning and restrained.

name: Fabricate
summary: Turn raw materials into finished items of the same material.

name: Find Greater Steed
summary: Summon a loyal, intelligent mount such as a griffon, pegasus, peryton, dire wolf, rhinoceros or saber-toothed tiger.

name: Fire Shield
summary: Warm or chill flames give you cold or fire resistance, and creatures that hit you in melee take 2d8 fire or cold.

name: Freedom of Movement
summary: For an hour a creature ignores difficult terrain and can't be paralyzed, restrained or magically slowed.

name: Giant Insect
summary: Grow centipedes, spiders, wasps or a scorpion into giant versions that obey you.

name: Grasping Vine
summary: A vine sprouts; as a bonus action each turn it lashes at a creature within 30 ft: DEX save or pulled 20 ft toward it.

name: Greater Invisibility
summary: A creature turns invisible for 1 minute, even while attacking or casting.

name: Guardian of Faith
summary: A spectral guardian appears: enemies moving within 10 ft make a DEX save or take 20 radiant (half on save); it vanishes after dealing 60.

name: Guardian of Nature
summary: Become a Primal Beast (+10 speed, advantage on STR attacks, +1d6 force on melee hits) or a Great Tree (10 temp HP, CON save advantage).

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
summary: Make natural terrain in a 150-ft cube look, sound and smell like another kind of terrain for 24 hours.

name: Ice Storm
summary: Hail pounds a 20-ft-radius cylinder: DEX save, 2d8 bludgeoning + 4d6 cold (half on save), leaving difficult terrain. +1d8 bludgeoning per slot.

name: Leomund's Secret Chest
summary: Hide a chest and its contents on the Ethereal Plane and recall it at will.

name: Locate Creature
summary: Sense the direction of a familiar creature or kind of creature within 1,000 ft.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
summary: An invisible watchdog barks at intruders and bites hostile creatures within 5 ft for 4d8 piercing.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
summary: Ward an area against sound, sight, scrying, teleportation and planar travel for 24 hours.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
summary: DEX save or a Large or smaller creature is sealed in an impenetrable sphere of force; nothing passes in or out.

name: Phantasmal Killer
summary: WIS save or frightened by its worst fear, taking 4d10 psychic at the end of each of its turns until it saves; +1d10 per slot.

name: Polymorph
summary: WIS save (if unwilling) or turn a creature into a beast of CR up to its level; it reverts when the new form hits 0 HP.

name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
summary: INT save, 7d6 psychic and incapacitated until your next turn (half, no effect on save); you can target by name. +1d6 per slot.

name: Sickening Radiance
summary: 30-ft sphere of sickly light: creatures starting a turn inside make a CON save or take 4d10 radiant and gain a level of exhaustion; they can't be invisible.

name: Staggering Smite
summary: Your next melee weapon hit deals +4d6 psychic and the target makes a WIS save or has disadvantage on attacks and checks and no reactions until its next turn ends.

name: Stone Shape
summary: Reshape a 5-ft cube of stone into any form you like.

name: Stoneskin
summary: A creature resists nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for an hour (100 gp diamond dust).

name: Storm Sphere
summary: 20-ft sphere of wind: difficult terrain, STR save or 2d6 bludgeoning when ending a turn inside; bonus action lightning bolt from it (spell attack, 4d6). +1d6 each per slot.

repeat.label: Storm Sphere: lightning
repeat.desc: Ranged spell attack from the sphere, 4d6 lightning.

name: Summon Aberration
summary: Call an aberrant spirit (beholderkin, slaad or star spawn) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Summon Construct
summary: Call a construct spirit (clay, metal or stone) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Summon Elemental
summary: Call an elemental spirit (air, earth, fire or water) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Summon Greater Demon
summary: Summon a demon of CR 5 or lower that may break free of your control; higher CR at higher slots.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
summary: 20-ft sphere of acid: DEX save, 10d4 acid plus 5d4 at the end of its next turn on a failure; half initial damage on save. +2d4 per slot.

name: Wall of Fire
summary: A 60-ft wall or 20-ft ring of fire: DEX save, 5d8 fire (half) when it appears; creatures ending turns on its hot side or inside take 5d8. +1d8 per slot.

name: Watery Sphere
summary: A 10-ft sphere of water: creatures in it make a STR save or are restrained and carried along (repeat save each turn).

name: Gravity Sinkhole
summary: 20-ft sphere: CON save, 5d10 force and pulled toward the centre (half, no pull on save); +1d10 per slot.

name: Animate Objects
summary: Animate up to ten Tiny objects (fewer larger ones) that attack on your command; +2 objects per slot.

name: Antilife Shell
summary: A 10-ft barrier around you that living creatures other than undead and constructs can't pass or reach through.

name: Awaken
summary: Over 8 hours give a beast or plant an Intelligence of 10 and speech; it is charmed by you for 30 days.

name: Banishing Smite
summary: Your next weapon hit deals +5d10 force, and if that leaves the target at 50 HP or fewer it is banished.

name: Bigby's Hand
summary: A Large force hand you command: punch (melee spell attack, 4d8 force), shove, grapple (2d6 + mod crush) or block. +2d8 per slot.

repeat.label: Bigby's Hand: punch
repeat.desc: The hand punches: melee spell attack, 4d8 force.

name: Circle of Power
summary: 30-ft aura: allies have advantage on saves against spells and take no damage when they succeed on a half-damage save.

name: Cloudkill
summary: A 20-ft sphere of poison fog that drifts 10 ft a turn: CON save on entering or starting a turn, 5d8 poison, half on save. +1d8 per slot.

name: Commune
summary: Ask your deity up to three yes-or-no questions.

name: Commune with Nature
summary: Learn up to three facts about the surrounding land within 3 miles (300 ft underground).

name: Cone of Cold
summary: 60-ft cone of frost: CON save, 8d8 cold, half on save; +1d8 per slot.

name: Conjure Elemental
summary: Summon an elemental of CR 5 or lower that turns hostile if concentration breaks; +1 CR per slot.

name: Conjure Volley
summary: Ammunition rains on a 40-ft-radius cylinder: DEX save, 8d8 of the weapon's damage type, half on save.

name: Contact Other Plane
summary: Ask an otherworldly entity five questions, risking 6d6 psychic and insanity on a failed DC 15 INT save.

name: Contagion
summary: Melee spell attack: the target is poisoned and, after three failed CON saves, catches a disease you choose for 7 days.

name: Control Winds
summary: Control air in a 100-ft cube: gusts, downdraft or updraft.

name: Creation
summary: Create a nonliving object of vegetable or mineral matter up to a 5-ft cube; duration depends on material.

name: Danse Macabre
summary: Animate up to five corpses as zombies or skeletons that add your modifier to attacks and damage; +2 per slot.

name: Dawn
summary: A 30-ft-radius cylinder of sunlight: CON save, 4d10 radiant (half) when it appears and at the end of each of your turns; move it 60 ft as a bonus action.

repeat.label: Move Dawn
repeat.desc: Move the cylinder of light up to 60 ft.

name: Destructive Wave
summary: Creatures you choose within 30 ft: CON save, 5d6 thunder + 5d6 radiant or necrotic and knocked prone; half and standing on save.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
summary: Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead attack you with disadvantage; end the spell to banish one by touch or free a charmed ally.

name: Dominate Person
summary: WIS save (advantage if fighting) or a humanoid is charmed and obeys your commands; it saves again when damaged. Longer at higher slots.

name: Dream
summary: Speak to a sleeping creature through its dreams, or send a nightmare (3d6 psychic, no rest) on a failed WIS save.

name: Enervation
summary: DEX save or 4d8 necrotic now and each turn you use your action (you heal half); 2d8 and the spell ends on a save. +1d8 per slot.

name: Far Step
summary: Teleport up to 60 ft now and again as a bonus action on each of your turns while the spell lasts.

repeat.label: Far Step: teleport
repeat.desc: Teleport up to 60 ft again.

name: Flame Strike
summary: A 10-ft-radius pillar of divine fire: DEX save, 4d6 fire + 4d6 radiant, half on save; +1d6 per slot.

name: Geas
summary: WIS save or a creature must follow your command for 30 days, taking 5d10 psychic when it defies it.

name: Greater Restoration
summary: Remove a level of exhaustion, a charm, petrification, a curse, or an ability or HP maximum reduction (100 gp diamond dust).

name: Hallow
summary: Over 24 hours consecrate a 60-ft area against certain creature types and bind an extra effect to it.

name: Hold Monster
summary: WIS save or any creature is paralyzed, repeating the save each turn; +1 target per slot.

name: Holy Weapon
summary: A weapon deals +2d8 radiant on hits; end it to burst within 30 ft: CON save, 4d8 radiant and blinded, half and not blinded on save.

repeat.label: Holy Weapon: burst
repeat.desc: End the spell: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a CON save, 4d8 radiant and blinded (half, not blinded on save).

name: Immolation
summary: DEX save or 8d6 fire and keeps burning for 4d6 each turn until it saves; half and no burning on save.

name: Infernal Calling
summary: Summon a devil of CR 6 or lower that is not reliably under your control; higher CR at higher slots.

name: Insect Plague
summary: A 20-ft sphere of locusts: CON save on entering or starting a turn, 4d10 piercing, half on save; difficult terrain. +1d10 per slot.

name: Legend Lore
summary: Learn significant lore about a famous person, place or object.

name: Maelstrom
summary: A 30-ft-radius whirlpool: difficult terrain; creatures starting a turn in it make a STR save or take 6d6 bludgeoning and are pulled 10 ft toward the centre.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
summary: Up to six creatures in a 30-ft sphere regain 3d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP; +1d8 per slot.

name: Mislead
summary: You become invisible while an illusory double of you appears and acts as you direct.

name: Modify Memory
summary: WIS save or you reshape a creature's memory of an event from the last 24 hours.

name: Negative Energy Flood
summary: CON save or 5d12 necrotic (half on save); undead gain 5d12 temp HP instead, and a creature killed rises as a zombie.

name: Passwall
summary: Open a passage up to 20 ft deep through wood, plaster or stone for an hour.

name: Planar Binding
summary: CHA save or a celestial, elemental, fey or fiend must serve you for 24 hours; longer at higher slots.

name: Raise Dead
summary: Return a creature dead up to 10 days to life with 1 HP and a -4 penalty that fades over rests (500 gp diamond).

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
summary: Link up to eight willing creatures telepathically for an hour.

name: Reincarnate
summary: Bring a creature dead up to 10 days back in a new, randomly determined body.

name: Scrying
summary: WIS save or you spy on a creature through an invisible sensor anywhere on the same plane.

name: Seeming
summary: Change the appearance of any number of creatures for 8 hours (CHA save if unwilling).

name: Skill Empowerment
summary: A creature gains expertise in one skill it is proficient in for an hour.

name: Steel Wind Strike
summary: Make a melee spell attack against up to five creatures within 30 ft, 6d10 force each on a hit, then teleport next to one of them.

name: Summon Celestial
summary: Call a celestial spirit (avenger or defender) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Summon Draconic Spirit
summary: Call a draconic spirit (chromatic, gem or metallic) with a breath weapon that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Swift Quiver
summary: Your quiver never runs dry, and you can make two ranged weapon attacks as a bonus action each turn.

name: Synaptic Static
summary: 20-ft sphere: INT save, 8d6 psychic (half on save); on a failure, subtract 1d6 from attacks, checks and concentration saves for a minute.

name: Telekinesis
summary: Move a creature (contested check, restrained) or an object up to 1,000 lb with your mind.

name: Teleportation Circle
summary: Open a portal to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.

name: Temporal Shunt
summary: Reaction when a creature attacks or casts: WIS save or it vanishes until your next turn, wasting the action; +1 target per slot.

name: Transmute Rock
summary: Turn a 40-ft cube of rock into mud (restraining creatures) or mud into rock.

name: Tree Stride
summary: Step into a tree and out of another of the same kind within 500 ft, once per turn.

name: Wall of Force
summary: An invisible, indestructible wall, dome or sphere of force that nothing physical can pass.

name: Wall of Light
summary: A 60-ft wall of light: CON save, 4d8 radiant and blinded (half, not blinded on save); fire rays from it as a spell attack (4d8). +1d8 per slot.

repeat.label: Wall of Light: ray
repeat.desc: A ray from the wall: ranged spell attack, 4d8 radiant.

name: Wall of Stone
summary: Raise a wall of ten 10-ft stone panels that becomes permanent if you hold concentration for 10 minutes.

name: Wrath of Nature
summary: Nature in a 60-ft cube turns on your foes: grasping undergrowth, lashing trees, roots that restrain and hurled rocks.

name: Arcane Gate
summary: Open two linked portals up to 500 ft apart.

name: Blade Barrier
summary: A 100-ft wall of whirling blades: DEX save, 6d10 slashing (half) on entering or starting a turn in it; cover and difficult terrain.

name: Bones of the Earth
summary: Up to six stone pillars burst from the ground, lifting creatures (DEX save) and crushing them against ceilings for 6d6 bludgeoning.

name: Chain Lightning
summary: A bolt hits one target then arcs to three others within 30 ft: DEX save each, 10d8 lightning, half on save; +1 arc per slot.

name: Circle of Death
summary: A 60-ft sphere of negative energy: CON save, 8d6 necrotic, half on save; +2d6 per slot.

name: Conjure Fey
summary: Summon a fey creature of CR 6 or lower that turns hostile if concentration breaks; +1 CR per slot.

name: Contingency
summary: Store a spell of 5th level or lower that casts itself on you when a condition you set occurs.

name: Create Homunculus
summary: Create a homunculus companion bound to you, sharing your hit dice.

name: Create Undead
summary: Raise up to three ghouls (or ghasts, wights, mummies at higher slots) under your control for 24 hours.

name: Disintegrate
summary: A ray: DEX save or 10d6 + 40 force, reducing a creature at 0 HP to dust; no damage on a save. +3d6 per slot.

name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
summary: Mark an object with a sapphire so you can crush the gem to summon it to your hand.

name: Eyebite
summary: Each turn, pick a creature within 60 ft: WIS save or it falls asleep, panics (frightened and fleeing) or sickens (disadvantage).

repeat.label: Eyebite: gaze
repeat.desc: Target another creature: WIS save or asleep/panicked/sickened.

name: Find the Path
summary: Know the shortest, most direct route to a fixed location on the same plane.

name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
summary: A creature gains half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison, and evasion; move the shield as a bonus action.

name: Flesh to Stone
summary: CON save or restrained and slowly hardening: three failed saves petrify it, three successes end the spell.

name: Forbiddance
summary: Ward up to 40,000 sq ft against teleportation and planar travel, damaging chosen creature types (5d10) inside.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
summary: A 10-ft barrier around you blocks spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside; +1 level blocked per slot.

name: Gravity Fissure
summary: 100-ft line: CON save, 8d8 force (half on save); creatures within 10 ft of the line are pulled toward it and take the damage on a failure. +1d8 per slot.

name: Guards and Wards
summary: Ward up to 2,500 sq ft of a stronghold with fog, webs, locked doors, confusing passages and other effects.

name: Harm
summary: CON save or 14d6 necrotic and HP maximum reduced by the same (half, no reduction on save); can't drop the target below 1 HP.

name: Heal
summary: A creature regains 70 HP and is cured of blindness, deafness and diseases; +10 HP per slot.

name: Heroes' Feast
summary: Up to twelve creatures share a feast: cured of disease and poison, immune to poison and fear, +2d10 max HP for 24 hours.

name: Investiture of Flame
summary: You blaze with fire: immune to fire, resist cold, creatures ending a turn near you take 1d10 fire, and you can shoot a 15-ft line of flame (DEX save, 4d8).

repeat.label: Investiture of Flame: fire line
repeat.desc: 15-ft line: DEX save, 4d8 fire (half on save).

name: Investiture of Ice
summary: Frost covers you: immune to cold, resist fire, ground within 10 ft is difficult terrain for others, and you can blast a 15-ft cone (CON save, 4d6 cold).

repeat.label: Investiture of Ice: frost cone
repeat.desc: 15-ft cone: CON save, 4d6 cold (half on save); on a failure speed is halved until your next turn.

name: Investiture of Stone
summary: You resist nonmagical weapon damage, move through stone, and can shake the ground in 15 ft (DEX save or prone).

repeat.label: Investiture of Stone: tremor
repeat.desc: Each creature within 15 ft: DEX save or prone.

name: Investiture of Wind
summary: Winds swirl around you: ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage, you fly at 60 ft, and you can hurl a 15-ft cube gust (CON save, 2d10).

repeat.label: Investiture of Wind: gust
repeat.desc: 15-ft cube: CON save, 2d10 bludgeoning and pushed 10 ft (half, no push on save).

name: Magic Jar
summary: Move your soul into a container and possess nearby humanoids (CHA save).

name: Mass Suggestion
summary: Up to twelve creatures make a WIS save or follow a reasonable suggestion for 24 hours.

name: Mental Prison
summary: INT save, 5d10 psychic (half on save); on a failure the target is trapped in an illusory prison and takes 10d10 if it leaves.

name: Move Earth
summary: Reshape dirt, sand or clay in a 40-ft area every 10 minutes for 2 hours.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
summary: A frigid globe bursts in a 60-ft sphere: CON save, 10d6 cold, half on save; can freeze water or be held as a grenade. +1d6 per slot.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
summary: No initial save: the target dances in place, attacks with disadvantage, and is attacked with advantage; it uses its action for a WIS save to stop.

name: Planar Ally
summary: Beseech your deity for a celestial, elemental or fiend who will serve you for payment.

name: Primordial Ward
summary: Gain resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder; end it as a reaction to become immune to one triggering type for a turn.

name: Programmed Illusion
summary: Create an illusion that plays out when a trigger you set occurs.

name: Scatter
summary: Teleport up to five creatures within 30 ft to spots within 120 ft of you (WIS save to resist).

name: Soul Cage
summary: Reaction when a humanoid dies: trap its soul to heal 2d8, ask questions, or gain advantage, up to six times.

name: Summon Fiend
summary: Call a fiendish spirit (demon, devil or yugoloth) that fights for you; stronger at higher slots.

name: Sunbeam
summary: A 60-ft line of sunlight: CON save, 6d8 radiant and blinded until your next turn (half, not blinded on save); repeat as an action.

repeat.label: Sunbeam: beam
repeat.desc: Another 60-ft line of sunlight.

name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
summary: Take on an Upper or Lower Planes form: 40-ft fly, +2 AC, immunity to two damage types, spellcasting-ability weapon attacks and an extra attack.

name: Tenser's Transformation
summary: Gain 50 temp HP, advantage on weapon attacks, +2d12 force on weapon hits, martial proficiencies and an extra attack.

name: Transport via Plants
summary: Link a plant to another of the same kind anywhere on the plane so creatures can step between them.

name: True Seeing
summary: A creature gains truesight to 120 ft for an hour.

name: Wall of Ice
summary: A wall or dome of ice: DEX save, 10d6 cold (half) when it appears; breaking through leaves frigid air (5d6 cold, CON save half). +2d6 per slot.

name: Wall of Thorns
summary: A 60-ft wall of thorns: DEX save, 7d8 piercing (half) when it appears; moving through costs 4 ft per foot and deals 7d8 slashing. +1d8 per slot.

name: Wind Walk
summary: You and up to ten creatures become clouds that fly at 300 ft for 8 hours.

name: Word of Recall
summary: Teleport you and up to five willing creatures to a sanctuary you designated.

name: Conjure Celestial
summary: Summon a celestial of CR 4 or lower (CR 5 with a 9th-level slot) that is friendly to you.

name: Crown of Stars
summary: Seven motes orbit you; as a bonus action fire one at a creature within 120 ft: ranged spell attack, 4d12 radiant. +2 motes per slot.

repeat.label: Crown of Stars: mote
repeat.desc: Fling a mote: ranged spell attack, 4d12 radiant.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
summary: A bead that explodes when concentration ends: 20-ft sphere, DEX save, 12d6 fire (half), +1d6 for each turn it waited. +1d6 per slot.

repeat.label: Delayed Blast Fireball: detonate
repeat.desc: End the spell: the bead bursts now.

name: Divine Word
summary: Creatures you choose make a CHA save or suffer by current HP: deafened (50 or less), blinded (40), stunned (30), or killed (20).

name: Draconic Transformation
summary: Gain blindsight 30 ft and a 60-ft fly speed, and exhale a 60-ft cone (DEX save, 6d8 force, half) now and as a bonus action each turn.

repeat.label: Draconic Transformation: breath
repeat.desc: Exhale another 60-ft cone (DEX save, 6d8 force).

name: Dream of the Blue Veil
summary: You and up to eight willing creatures dream your way to another world of the Material Plane.

name: Etherealness
summary: Step into the Ethereal Plane for up to 8 hours; +3 creatures per slot.

name: Finger of Death
summary: CON save, 7d8 + 30 necrotic, half on save; a humanoid killed rises as your zombie.

name: Fire Storm
summary: Ten 10-ft cubes of flame: DEX save, 7d10 fire, half on save; you can spare plants.

name: Forcecage
summary: An invisible cube or cage of force traps creatures for an hour with no save; teleporting out needs a CHA save. 1,500 gp ruby dust.

name: Mirage Arcane
summary: Make up to a square mile of terrain look, sound, smell and even feel like other terrain for 10 days.

name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
summary: Open a door to a lavish extradimensional mansion with servants and a feast for 24 hours.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
summary: A force sword attacks a creature within 5 ft of it (melee spell attack, 3d10 force) now and as a bonus action each turn.

repeat.label: Mordenkainen's Sword: strike
repeat.desc: The sword attacks: melee spell attack, 3d10 force.

name: Plane Shift
summary: Carry up to nine willing creatures to another plane, or banish an unwilling one with a melee spell attack and CHA save.

name: Power Word Pain
summary: A creature with 100 HP or fewer is wracked: speed 10 ft max, disadvantage on attacks, checks and most saves; CON save each turn to end.

name: Prismatic Spray
summary: 60-ft cone of eight coloured rays: DEX save; each creature is hit by a random ray, most dealing 10d6 of an element (half on save), others restraining or banishing.

name: Project Image
summary: Create an illusory duplicate of yourself up to 500 miles away that you can see, hear and speak through.

name: Regenerate
summary: A creature regains 4d8 + 15 HP, then 1 HP every round for an hour, and severed parts regrow.

name: Resurrection
summary: Return a creature dead up to a century to life with full HP (1,000 gp diamond).

name: Reverse Gravity
summary: Reverse gravity in a 50-ft-radius cylinder so unanchored creatures fall upward (DEX save to grab hold).

name: Sequester
summary: Hide a creature or object from divination and sight; a creature falls into suspended animation.

name: Simulacrum
summary: Craft an obedient duplicate of a creature with half its HP over 12 hours.

name: Symbol
summary: Inscribe a glyph that triggers death, discord, fear, hopelessness, insanity, pain, sleep or stunning.

name: Teleport
summary: Teleport yourself and up to eight creatures, or an object, to a destination on the same plane; accuracy depends on familiarity.

name: Temple of the Gods
summary: Raise a temple to your deity that hinders certain creature types and boosts healing inside.

name: Tether Essence
summary: Two creatures make CON saves or become linked: damage and healing taken by one also affects the other.

name: Whirlwind
summary: A 10-ft-radius whirlwind that you move: DEX save, 10d6 bludgeoning (half); creatures may be sucked in and restrained.

repeat.label: Move Whirlwind
repeat.desc: Move the whirlwind up to 30 ft.

name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting
summary: Draw moisture from a 30-ft cube: CON save, 12d8 necrotic, half on save (worse for plants and water elementals).

name: Animal Shapes
summary: Turn any number of willing creatures into beasts of CR 4 or lower.

name: Antimagic Field
summary: A 10-ft sphere around you where spells and magic items stop working.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
summary: Make a target repel or attract a chosen kind of creature for 10 days (WIS save).

name: Clone
summary: Grow an inert duplicate body that your soul enters if you die.

name: Control Weather
summary: Change the weather within 5 miles over time.

name: Dark Star
summary: A 40-ft sphere of darkness and gravity: silenced difficult terrain; creatures entering or starting a turn inside make a CON save, 8d10 force, half on save.

name: Demiplane
summary: Create a shadowy door to an empty 30-ft room demiplane.

name: Dominate Monster
summary: WIS save (advantage if fighting) or any creature is charmed and obeys you; it saves again when damaged.

name: Earthquake
summary: A 100-ft-radius quake: difficult terrain, DEX save or prone each turn, concentration checks, fissures and collapsing structures.

name: Feeblemind
summary: 4d6 psychic, then INT save or INT and CHA become 1: no spells, items or language; repeat save every 30 days.

name: Glibness
summary: For an hour, treat any CHA check roll below 15 as 15, and magic can't detect your lies.

name: Holy Aura
summary: Allies within 30 ft have advantage on saves and attacks against them have disadvantage; fiends and undead hitting them may be blinded.

name: Illusory Dragon
summary: A Huge shadow dragon frightens those who see it (WIS save) and breathes a 60-ft cone as a bonus action: INT save, 7d6 of a chosen type, half on save.

repeat.label: Illusory Dragon: breath
repeat.desc: The dragon breathes a 60-ft cone (INT save, 7d6).

name: Incendiary Cloud
summary: A 20-ft sphere of embers drifting 10 ft a turn: DEX save, 10d8 fire (half) when it appears and on entering or ending a turn inside.

name: Maddening Darkness
summary: A 60-ft sphere of magical darkness filled with whispers: WIS save at the end of each turn inside, 8d8 psychic, half on save.

name: Maze
summary: Banish a creature into a labyrinth demiplane; it escapes with a DC 20 INT check as an action.

name: Mighty Fortress
summary: Raise a stone fortress with towers and servants for 7 days.

name: Mind Blank
summary: A creature becomes immune to psychic damage, mind reading, divination and the charmed condition for 24 hours.

name: Power Word Stun
summary: A creature with 150 HP or fewer is stunned, making a CON save at the end of each of its turns to recover.

name: Reality Break
summary: WIS save each turn or reality tears at the target: stunned, 6d12 psychic, 8d12 force and teleported, or 10d12 cold and blinded.

name: Sunburst
summary: A 60-ft sphere of sunlight: CON save, 12d6 radiant and blinded for a minute (half, not blinded on save); repeat save each turn.

name: Telepathy
summary: Form a telepathic link with a familiar creature on the same plane for 24 hours.

name: Tsunami
summary: A 300-ft wall of water crashes down: STR save, 6d10 bludgeoning (half), then moves away, weakening each round.

name: Astral Projection
summary: Project yourself and up to eight others into the Astral Plane, leaving bodies in suspended animation.

name: Blade of Disaster
summary: A planar rift blade: make up to two melee spell attacks (4d12 force, crits on 18+ for 12d12), moving it and attacking again as a bonus action.

repeat.label: Blade of Disaster: strike
repeat.desc: Two melee spell attacks, 4d12 force each.

name: Foresight
summary: For 8 hours a creature can't be surprised, has advantage on attacks, checks and saves, and attacks against it have disadvantage.

name: Gate
summary: Open a portal to another plane, or name a creature to drag it through.

name: Imprisonment
summary: WIS save or a creature is magically imprisoned (burial, chaining, hedged prison, minimus or slumber) until freed.

name: Invulnerability
summary: You are immune to all damage for up to 10 minutes.

name: Mass Heal
summary: Divide up to 700 HP of healing among creatures in range, also curing blindness, deafness and diseases.

name: Mass Polymorph
summary: Up to ten creatures (WIS save if unwilling) become beasts of CR up to their CR or level.

name: Meteor Swarm
summary: Four meteors strike points within a mile: each 40-ft sphere, DEX save, 20d6 fire + 20d6 bludgeoning, half on save; a creature is hit only once.

name: Power Word Heal
summary: A creature regains all its HP and is freed of charm, fright, paralysis and stun; it can stand as a reaction.

name: Power Word Kill
summary: A creature with 100 HP or fewer dies instantly; no save.

name: Prismatic Wall
summary: A wall or sphere of seven coloured layers, each blocking something and harming those who pass.

name: Psychic Scream
summary: Up to ten creatures with INT over 2: INT save, 14d6 psychic and stunned (repeat save each turn); half and not stunned on save.

name: Ravenous Void
summary: A 20-ft sphere of crushing gravity pulls creatures within 100 ft inward; those starting a turn inside make a CON save, 5d10 force and restrained (half on save).

name: Shapechange
summary: Transform into any creature of CR up to your level, changing form as an action.

name: Storm of Vengeance
summary: A 360-ft-radius storm: CON save, 2d6 thunder and deafened as it forms, then acid rain, lightning, hail and freezing wind in later rounds.

name: Time Ravage
summary: CON save or 10d12 necrotic and aged to the brink of death within 30 days (half, no aging on save).

name: Time Stop
summary: Take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row; it ends if you affect another creature.

name: True Polymorph
summary: WIS save (if unwilling) or transform a creature or object into another creature or object; permanent after a full hour.

name: True Resurrection
summary: Restore a creature dead up to 200 years to full life with a new body if needed (25,000 gp diamonds).

name: Weird
summary: Creatures of your choice in a 30-ft sphere: WIS save or frightened, taking 4d10 psychic at the end of each turn until they save.

name: Wish
summary: Duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower without components, or attempt a greater effect at a risk.
